webhook.TRELLO_ATTACHMENT_ADDED_TO_CARD.title: Attachment Added To Card
webhook.TRELLO_ATTACHMENT_ADDED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when a file or link is attached to a card.

webhook.TRELLO_ATTACHMENT_REMOVED_FROM_C.title: Attachment Removed From Card
webhook.TRELLO_ATTACHMENT_REMOVED_FROM_C.description: Triggers when an attachment is removed from a card. Trello drops the attachment's URL from this event.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_ADDED_TO_WORKSPACE.title: Board Added To Workspace
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_ADDED_TO_WORKSPACE.description: Triggers when a board enters the watched Workspace — the Trello equivalent of a new project starting. Covers both a board created inside the Workspace and an existing board moved into it.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_CREATED.title: Board Label Created
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_CREATED.description: Triggers when a label is added to the board's label set. Applying an existing label to a card is TRELLO_LABEL_ADDED_TO_CARD.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_DELETED.title: Board Label Deleted
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_DELETED.description: Triggers when a label is deleted from the board's label set. Trello drops the label's text and colour from this event.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_UPDATED.title: Board Label Updated
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_LABEL_UPDATED.description: Triggers when a board label changes. `old` carries the previous value of the field that changed.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_MEMBER_ROLE_CHANGED.title: Board Member Role Changed
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_MEMBER_ROLE_CHANGED.description: Triggers when a board member is promoted to admin or demoted to a normal member. `role` says which they hold now. Changes to and from Trello's observer role are not covered.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_REMOVED_FROM_WORKSP.title: Board Removed From Workspace
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_REMOVED_FROM_WORKSP.description: Triggers when a board leaves the watched Workspace.

webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_UPDATED.title: Board Updated
webhook.TRELLO_BOARD_UPDATED.description: Triggers when the watched board is renamed, its description changes, it is closed or reopened, or one of its preferences changes — commenting, self-join, voting or card covers. `old` carries the previous value of the one field that changed. Board visibility changes emit no Trello event, so this never fires for a board becoming public or private.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_COPIED.title: Card Copied
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_COPIED.description: Triggers when a card is duplicated onto the watched board. The copy is the card in the payload; `source_card` is the one it came from.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_CREATED.title: Card Created
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_CREATED.description: Triggers when a new card is typed onto the watched board. A card that arrives by being copied, converted from a checklist item, or moved in from another board has its own trigger.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_CREATED_FROM_CHECKLI.title: Card Created From Checklist Item
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_CREATED_FROM_CHECKLI.description: Triggers when a checklist item is promoted into a card of its own — a sub-task becoming tracked work.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_DELETED.title: Card Deleted
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_DELETED.description: Triggers when a card is permanently deleted from the watched board. Trello drops the card's title from this event, so only its ids are available.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_BETWEEN_LISTS.title: Card Moved Between Lists
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_BETWEEN_LISTS.description: Triggers when a card moves from one list to another on the watched board — the hook for stage-change automations such as 'when a card reaches Done, close the linked issue'. Moving a card within its own list changes only its position and emits nothing.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_IN_FROM_ANOTHE.title: Card Moved In From Another Board
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_IN_FROM_ANOTHE.description: Triggers when a card is moved onto the watched board from a different one — a triage board handing work to a sprint board, say.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_OUT_TO_ANOTHER.title: Card Moved Out To Another Board
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_OUT_TO_ANOTHER.description: Triggers when a card leaves the watched board for a different one.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_UPDATED.title: Card Updated
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_UPDATED.description: Triggers when a card's title, description, due date, start date, completion checkbox or archived state changes. `old` carries the previous value of the one field that changed and `card` carries the new one. Moving a card to a different list is TRELLO_CARD_MOVED_BETWEEN_LISTS instead.

webhook.TRELLO_CARD_VOTE_CHANGED.title: Card Vote Changed
webhook.TRELLO_CARD_VOTE_CHANGED.description: Triggers when a vote is cast on or withdrawn from a card — `voted` says which. Voting has to be enabled on the board for this to be possible.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ADDED_TO_CARD.title: Checklist Added To Card
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ADDED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when a checklist is attached to a card.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_ADDED.title: Checklist Item Added
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_ADDED.description: Triggers when an item is added to a checklist.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_DELETED.title: Checklist Item Deleted
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_DELETED.description: Triggers when an item is deleted from a checklist.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_STATE_CHAN.title: Checklist Item State Changed
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_STATE_CHAN.description: Triggers when a checklist item is ticked off or un-ticked. `check_item.state` says which.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_UPDATED.title: Checklist Item Updated
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_ITEM_UPDATED.description: Triggers when a checklist item changes. `old` carries the previous value of the field that changed.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_REMOVED_FROM_CA.title: Checklist Removed From Card
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_REMOVED_FROM_CA.description: Triggers when a checklist is deleted from a card.

webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_UPDATED.title: Checklist Updated
webhook.TRELLO_CHECKLIST_UPDATED.description: Triggers when a checklist changes. `old` carries the previous value of the field that changed.

webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_ADDED_TO_CARD.title: Comment Added To Card
webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_ADDED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when someone comments on a card. Comments carried over by copying a card are TRELLO_COMMENT_COPIED_TO_CARD, so this never replays history.

webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_COPIED_TO_CARD.title: Comment Copied To Card
webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_COPIED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when a comment is carried onto a new card by copying the card it was on. Copying a card with ten comments emits ten of these at once, all of them historical — mirror them, do not treat them as new activity.

webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_DELETED_FROM_CARD.title: Comment Deleted From Card
webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_DELETED_FROM_CARD.description: Triggers when a comment is deleted from a card. Trello drops the comment text from this event.

webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_EDITED_ON_CARD.title: Comment Edited On Card
webhook.TRELLO_COMMENT_EDITED_ON_CARD.description: Triggers when an existing comment on a card is edited.

webhook.TRELLO_LABEL_ADDED_TO_CARD.title: Label Added To Card
webhook.TRELLO_LABEL_ADDED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when a label is applied to a card — the hook for triage automations such as 'when Urgent is applied, page on-call'.

webhook.TRELLO_LABEL_REMOVED_FROM_CARD.title: Label Removed From Card
webhook.TRELLO_LABEL_REMOVED_FROM_CARD.description: Triggers when a label is taken off a card.

webhook.TRELLO_LIST_CREATED.title: List Created
webhook.TRELLO_LIST_CREATED.description: Triggers when a new list is added to the watched board.

webhook.TRELLO_LIST_MOVED_IN_FROM_ANOTHE.title: List Moved In From Another Board
webhook.TRELLO_LIST_MOVED_IN_FROM_ANOTHE.description: Triggers when a whole list is moved onto the watched board from a different one.

webhook.TRELLO_LIST_MOVED_OUT_TO_ANOTHER.title: List Moved Out To Another Board
webhook.TRELLO_LIST_MOVED_OUT_TO_ANOTHER.description: Triggers when a whole list is moved off the watched board to a different one.

webhook.TRELLO_LIST_UPDATED.title: List Updated
webhook.TRELLO_LIST_UPDATED.description: Triggers when a list is renamed, archived, restored, or moved to a different position on the board. `old` carries the previous value of the one field that changed and `list` carries the new one.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ADDED_TO_BOARD.title: Member Added To Board
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ADDED_TO_BOARD.description: Triggers when someone joins the watched board. An invitation to a person who has not accepted yet is TRELLO_MEMBER_INVITED_TO_BOARD.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ADDED_TO_WORKSPACE.title: Member Added To Workspace
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ADDED_TO_WORKSPACE.description: Triggers when someone joins the watched Workspace.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ASSIGNED_TO_CARD.title: Member Assigned To Card
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_ASSIGNED_TO_CARD.description: Triggers when a member is added to a card.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_INVITED_TO_BOARD.title: Member Invited To Board
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_INVITED_TO_BOARD.description: Triggers when someone is invited to the watched board and has not accepted yet. Trello does not name the invited person in this event — no email and no member id — so the payload carries the board and who sent the invitation. TRELLO_MEMBER_ADDED_TO_BOARD fires when they accept.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_REMOVED_FROM_BOARD.title: Member Removed From Board
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_REMOVED_FROM_BOARD.description: Triggers when someone leaves or is removed from the watched board.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_REMOVED_FROM_WORKS.title: Member Removed From Workspace
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_REMOVED_FROM_WORKS.description: Triggers when someone leaves or is removed from the watched Workspace.

webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_UNASSIGNED_FROM_CA.title: Member Unassigned From Card
webhook.TRELLO_MEMBER_UNASSIGNED_FROM_CA.description: Triggers when a member comes off a card.

webhook.TRELLO_WORKSPACE_UPDATED.title: Workspace Updated
webhook.TRELLO_WORKSPACE_UPDATED.description: Triggers when the watched Workspace's display name or description changes. `old` carries the previous value of the one field that changed.
